about.what: the level calibration by model as a paired 2 x 2 factorial on RS's stored runs, with the interaction and its paired SEs (report v2, section 6.3 and App E.4; work item W3)
about.sign: Delta = ALC(A) - ALC(B), or the signed sum of cells in `definition`; negative when the first-named side is better. Table T3 prints comparator minus hier-ship
about.se: cluster_se: level_calibration.Boot over (parent, subject) clusters (test-like) or (benchmark, subject) clusters (public), 2,000 resamples, seed 0, ratio estimator, as in RS; run_se: SE over runs, which understates (runs reuse public pairs); per regime only, the regimes share clusters
about.selects: nothing: descriptive, report only, scores nothing

design.eb_fit: HierPredictor over level_calibration.bundle(parent, 0.0) with the level prior as fitted

interaction.definition: ship - eb_fit - smcal + smooth = calibration_in_hier - calibration_in_smooth = model_at_calibrated - model_at_default

checks.name: cells_equal_rs_configs
checks.keys: summary.configs.<R>.<cell>.{ALC, ALC_run_se, ALC_cluster_se, q0, ece0, ece_alc, budgets}
